method: Paired bootstrap3 observed processes and3 source clusters/family; preserve all associated tenant/turn counts; numerator is actual SLO-compliant request count; each selected process keeps its observed service wall. Absolute Goodput change is the main sensitivity statistic.
zero_denominator: Retain zero-baseline draws; if any draw has zero baseline, report ratio interval as undefined. Never add pseudocount or drop unfavorable cells.
boundary: Conditional source-composition sensitivity only; no reweighted wall or new queue trajectory/capacity inferred. Original paired-process primary analysis unchanged.
motivation: Raw-only near-saturation profile yielded8/120 SLO-compliant requests; report absolute rates/counts and honest finite-source sensitivity, no load/SLO retuning.
